messages:
Nina Rao: Hey team, second-day onboarding hiccup. My laptop won't join the Redwood-Enterprise Wi-Fi. It asks for a certificate and then shows 'Authentication failed'. Phone hotspot works so I can join Zoom, but I need the corp network for internal docs. Raised ticket IT-3565 but posting here in case anyone has a quick tip.

Ivy (IT): Welcome Nina! Sorry about that. Quick Qs: macOS or Windows? Do you see a prompt to select a certificate or to enter username/password? And did you run the self-service profile from onboarding.redwood.com?

Nina Rao: macOS Sonoma 14.2. I get a dialog that says "Select a certificate" with a pulldown that is empty. I tried the onboarding link and clicked "Install Network Profile" but it errors with "Profile installation failed: unable to verify profile."

Rory (NetOps): Thanks for the details. That "Select a certificate" empty pulldown means the machine doesn't have the CA client cert we push via SSO. Two quick things: 1) Can you open Keychain Access -> System and check for an entry called "Redwood-CA"? 2) If the profile install failed, what's the exact error in Console.app under 'profiles' during install?

Nina Rao: Checked Keychain -> System: no "Redwood-CA". Console showed: "profilesd[1234]: failed to verify profile: certificate chain could not be validated"

Ivy (IT): That matches a cert trust issue. Are you on a corporate-managed laptop (MDM enrolled) or a personal machine?

Nina Rao: It's a company laptop I just received. Claimed in the onboarding flow but I might have skipped the MDM step accidentally.

Ivy (IT): If MDM enrollment didn't finish, the certs won't be pushed. Two options: A) Re-run the enrollment link (we'll reprovision) or B) use ethernet or the guest Wi-Fi temporarily. Can you join wired network at desk? If not, Sam can bring a USB-C ethernet adapter.

Sam (Workspace Ops): @Nina I can drop a spare USB-C -> RJ45 adapter at D12 in 15 minutes. Also we have a dock we can plug in to test.

Nina Rao: Thanks Sam, D12 works. Would prefer the network fixed rather than juggling guest Wi-Fi.

Rory (NetOps): OK Nina, I'm going to trigger a re-enroll for your device in MDM and push the CA cert. @Ivy can you confirm the device serial and AD username so I can target the profile?

Ivy (IT): Device serial is XZC12345 and username is nina.rao@redwood.ai. Pushing re-enroll now.

it-bot: IT ticket IT-3565 updated: Assigned to NetOps. Action: "Trigger MDM re-enrollment and push Redwood-CA cert." Priority: P2.

Rory (NetOps): Sent the enrollment invite and pushed the profile. You should get a macOS system prompt to allow the profile in System Settings -> Profiles. After allowing, reboot and try joining Redwood-Enterprise and choose EAP-TLS with certificate.

Nina Rao: Got the system prompt now. Installed the profile and see "Redwood-CA" in System Keychain. Rebooting.

Nina Rao: Reboot done. Tried to join Redwood-Enterprise and it connected! Verified internal sites load and Slack on corporate network. Thank you all.

Ivy (IT): Awesome. I'll update the ticket to note resolution steps and mark as P2 resolved. If you see intermittent drops, ping us and we'll run a capture.

Sam (Workspace Ops): Glad we could help. Welcome again Nina! :tada:

Nina Rao: Thanks folks 6mdash; appreciate the quick responses.
